djnw.summary_analysis: ACCO Brands reported second-quarter sales of $518.7 million, up 4% and above the $494.2 million FactSet consensus. Comparable sales increased 4.4% as pricing more than offset lower volume. Adjusted EPS was $0.36 versus $0.32 expected. ACCO improved its 2019 sales outlook to flat from flat to down 3% and raised the lower end of adjusted EPS guidance to $1.15 from $1.10, retaining a $1.20 upper end.
djnw.why_moved: ACCO shares rose 13% to $9.18 after adjusted earnings exceeded expectations and management improved its full-year sales and EPS guidance. The article's headline explicitly identifies earnings and guidance as the drivers, while the sales beat reinforced the positive reaction.

sources.title: ACCO Brands Up 13% After Earning, Guidance >ACCO
